narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional guide and advertisement for the Cathay United Bank CUBE Credit Card, specifically targeting Taiwanese travelers in South Korea. It highlights the card's 14.3% reward rate as a solution for high spending associated with tourism and fandom activities, providing a tutorial on how to activate these benefits within the bank's app.
